_comment: Filled in during Phase 0 bench verification (see mirror_bridge.py docstring). Do not guess these values -- run probe_joint_sign.py (sim) against safe_probe.py (real) per joint, and the gripper ramp check, before trusting this file.

sign._comment: 1 if a positive delta in Isaac Sim moves this joint the same physical direction as a positive delta sent to the real motor; -1 if opposite. Determine per-joint with safe_probe.py --side left --joint N --step 0.05 against probe_joint_sign.py.

offset_rad._comment: Optional small residual trim in radians, added after the sign flip. Leave at 0.0 if zero-calibration (openarm-can-set-zero) was done properly -- this is not a substitute for real zeroing.

gripper._comment: Raw LJ8/RJ8 motor value at fully-open and fully-closed. Re-measured 2026-08-25 after re-zeroing BOTH gripper motors at the firmly-closed stop with openarm-can-set-zero <canport> 008, which is the vendor convention (docs.openarm.dev motor-config: 'For grippers, the closed position is used as zero by default'). closed_raw is therefore exactly 0.0 now; it used to be open_raw that sat at ~0. The two open_raw values have OPPOSITE signs because the two gripper motors turn opposite ways to close -- that is real, not a typo, and is why openarm-can-zero-position-calibration's hardcoded +0.2 deg bump_to_limit() finds the CLOSED stop on the right arm and the OPEN stop on the left.
